raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Extend #62183 to support DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decoder-side SWA bounded replay with PCP and APC, including prefix-hit continuation.

## Claims

- Retain each request's global trailing window on its original PCP owners while preserving cached compressed KV and indexer keys.
- Keep prompt-logprobs rows and existing non-PCP behavior; padded peers participate in the same collectives and only real outputs are scattered back.

## Validation

**Follow-up validation (`35004b9295`, `cc13fe1e44`):** Selected PCP, model-runner, ubatch and replay CPU suites passed with **137 passed, 21 skipped**; changed-file pre-commit checks, including mypy, and `git diff --check` passed. The H20 results below cover `8689ce0`; GPU/NCCL, serving, model-quality and performance validation for these follow-ups remain **TODO**.

<details>
<summary>Follow-up check commands</summary>

```bash
# PYTHONPATH includes the local artifact scripts directory.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p pcp_comparison_pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_pcp.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_decoder_replay_layers.py -q
git diff --name-only a9bc61d68c | xargs .venv/bin/pre-commit run --show-diff-on-failure --files
git diff --check
```

The local plugin applies the repository-supported `skip_global_cleanup` marker for macOS CPU checks; it does not skip tests. The GPU replay-batch suite could not be run on this host.
</details>

- Model: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.
- Baseline: pinned nightly plus #62183 (`fc47cc8fff8282b7fa2b257468b8595f91a1a741`), encoder replay only.
- Candidate: identical baseline plus this PR at `8689ce06b2ac945c82e44cdb5ff52e925fc096bc`, with decoder replay enabled.
- Both services use the following launch command; node placement and the runtime overlay differ by arm:

```bash
vllm serve /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18001 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 4 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --moe-backend humming \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --swa-bounded-replay \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling
```

### Uncached 8K prefill performance

- Node-local benchmark clients.
- Direct token-ID prompts: 8,192 input tokens, one output token, request rate infinity, no warmup, and `N=10*C`.
- C1/N10 seed `210101`, C8/N80 seed `210108`, and C32/N320 seed `210132`.
- Both arms receive the same unique prompts. Every accepted run has zero prefix-cache hit tokens.

| Case | Baseline Input TPS | Candidate Input TPS | Candidate delta | Baseline Mean TTFT | Candidate Mean TTFT | Candidate delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| C1 / N10 | 13,933.06 | 21,994.20 | +57.86% | 587.75 ms | 372.25 ms | -36.66% |
| C8 / N80 | 14,240.95 | 22,866.70 | +60.57% | 4,399.97 ms | 2,739.59 ms | -37.74% |
| C32 / N320 | 14,252.14 | 22,894.56 | +60.64% | 17,499.31 ms | 10,890.08 ms | -37.77% |

All 820 requests across both arms succeeded. Decoder-side replay improves uncached 8K prefill throughput by 58-61% across C1-C32.

### Paired GSM8K accuracy

Full 1,319 samples, four-shot, batch 64, seed 42, temperature 0, top-p 1, reasoning effort `high`, and `max_tokens=8192`, using EvalScope 1.11.1:

| Arm | Correct | Accuracy | API errors | Max-token stops |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline | 1,286/1,319 | 97.498% | 0 | 0 |
| Candidate | 1,282/1,319 | 97.195% | 0 | 1 |

The arms used the same sample indexes, prompts, targets, and total input-token count. Paired outcomes were 1,278 both-correct, 29 both-wrong, 8 baseline-only correct, and 4 candidate-only correct. The exact two-sided McNemar test gives `p=0.387695`, so the observed 0.303 percentage-point difference is not statistically significant.

Both arms recorded exactly 674,816 / 803,206 local prefix-cache hit tokens (84.02%) and zero external cache-hit tokens. The sole candidate truncation was sample index 119, which reached 8,192 output tokens; the corresponding baseline request stopped normally at 6,955 output tokens.

Both service pods remained Ready with zero restarts. The performance and accuracy runs had zero API failures, and post-test logs contained no critical runtime, CUDA, or engine errors.

## Details

Reuse the existing replay batch, gather kernel and attention builders. Each PCP rank-local `InputBatch` carries compact PCP metadata: the unpadded global token count, per-segment global query and sequence-length bounds, and the PCP+DCP gather bound. Decoder replay derives local trailing rows and the same global kept-token padding bound on every rank without carrying the global batch or adding a PCP collective. Replay-start upload is deferred until PCP/DP agreement confirms replay is needed. Select local slots before compaction, gather them in rank-major order, and align MoE routing IDs with the compact rows. Batches that would not shrink after padding keep full execution.

Unlike #61554's APC-disabled cold-prefill path, this builds on #62183 for APC prefix hits and derives replay bounds from existing global PCP metadata. It retains the existing PCP restrictions and eager execution requirement, with no scheduler or configuration changes. The branch is rebased on #62183 now in main. AI assistance was used for implementation and static checks.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Tests on H20 platform.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

I think another simple way to do this is to add an optional pcp_global_batch field to InputBatch (see [here](https://github.com/wangyicong52/vllm/pull/3/changes/41e18e388bdca715768cc30f53e422460a4bb20f)) so we can drop this wrapper class. +    kv, latent = torch.arange(6).view(2, 3).float(), torch.ones(2, 3)

Would this look cleaner to you or do you have another approach in mind? Happy to hear your thoughts!
